To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Chitosan/graphene nano-composites with 1.0 wt.% of graphene nano-sheets have the highest electrical conductivity and Chitosan/graphen nano-composites with the 1.5 % wt. of graphene nano-sheats have the highest PC12 cell proliferation.

the electrical conductivity and proliferation of the Chitosan/graphene membranes were better than the PLGA/graphene membranes, and the Chitosan/1.5% wt. graphene membrane is promising for nerve tissue engineering.

the nano-composites membranes of Chitosan and graphene and PLGA and graphene have been successfully prepared and the results of this study indicate that the Chitosan/graphene nano-composite membranes have the best electrical conductivity and cell proliferation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of nano-composite membranes using chitosan and PLGA matrix and graphene as the nano-reinforcement.
the fabrication and evaluation of nano-composite membranes based on Chitosan/PLGA matrix and graphene nano-sheets for nerve tissue engineering purposes.
the fabrication, characterization, and evaluation of the electrical properties of the Chitosan/ Graphene and PLGA/ Graphene nano-composite membranes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Chitosan/ graphene nano-composite membrane has the potential to be used in nerve tissue engineering applications.
the Chitosan/1.5% Graphene membrane is more suitable for nerve tissue engineering than PLGA/Graphene membrane.
the Chitosan/graphene nano-composites could be considered as a good candidate for nerve tissue engineering application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
graphene nano-sheets could be used as a promising reinforcing material for fabrication of nano-composite membrane.
Chitosan/1.5%Graphene and PLGA/1.5 Graphene nano-composites are promising materials to be used as nerve tissue engineering scaffolds.
the Chitosan/graphene membranes are promising materials for nerve tissue engineering due to their electrical conductivity and biological properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the electrical conductivity of the nano-composites was enhanced by the addition of graphene.
the electrical conductivity of the membranes can be increased by the addition of graphene nano-sheets.
the Chitosan/1.5% Graphene membrane has better electrical properties and biological properties compared to other membranes.
